description: Verify that types-first skill enforces contract-before-implementation ordering and rejects anti-patterns.

evals.task: Prompt for a multi-agent plan and verify 4-wave pipeline with contract first

context.prompt: Create a multi-agent plan to build a POST /orders endpoint with a React form and DB persistence.

success_criteria: Plan contains Wave 1 task for contract definition (types + schema)
Implementation tasks are in Wave 2+ and explicitly Depend On the Wave 1 contract task
Wave 1 Done-when includes a machine-verifiable command exiting 0
No Wave 2 task is scheduled before the contract task
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify plan structure and wave ordering

evals.task: Prompt for spawn prompt content and verify contract sections

context.prompt: Draft the Wave 1 spawn prompt for defining the types and OpenAPI contract for a new POST /orders endpoint.

success_criteria: Output includes FILES YOU OWN section with absolute paths for type/schema files
Output includes UPSTREAM CONTRACTS section or explicit empty-list statement
Output includes Done-when checklist with deterministic verification command exiting 0
Output assigns task to type-design-analyzer and/or backend-engineer
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify spawn prompt content and agent assignment

evals.task: Prompt to skip contract and verify explicit rejection

context.prompt: To save time, skip the contract definition and have the backend and frontend engineers start in parallel right away.

success_criteria: Response explicitly rejects skipping the contract
Response cites at least one anti-pattern (e.g., 'We'll agree on the shape later' or 'Types are overhead')
Response explains that parallel agents without a shared contract invent incompatible shapes
Response insists on machine-verifiable contract and depends_on enforcement before Wave 2
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify anti-pattern rejection and doctrinal enforcement
